points.title: DIV completes with write
points.condition: A DIV instruction completes with pcpi_ready and pcpi_wr both high.

points.title: DIVU completes with write
points.condition: A DIVU instruction completes with pcpi_ready and pcpi_wr both high.

points.title: REM completes with write
points.condition: A REM instruction completes with pcpi_ready and pcpi_wr both high.

points.title: REMU completes with write
points.condition: A REMU instruction completes with pcpi_ready and pcpi_wr both high.

points.title: Wait high in first cycle of a division request
points.condition: In the first cycle of a division request pcpi_wait is already high.

points.title: Wait held on consecutive cycles
points.condition: pcpi_wait high in two consecutive cycles while pcpi_ready is low.

points.title: Wait still high after 16 cycles
points.condition: pcpi_wait high with pcpi_ready low at least 16 cycles into a request.

points.title: Wait still high after 31 cycles
points.condition: pcpi_wait high with pcpi_ready low at least 31 cycles into a request.

points.title: Completion in mid latency class
points.condition: Completion after 16 to 31 pending cycles.

points.title: Completion in long latency class
points.condition: Completion after 32 or more pending cycles.

points.title: DIV by zero
points.condition: DIV completes with rs2 equal to zero.

points.title: DIVU by zero
points.condition: DIVU completes with rs2 equal to zero.

points.title: REM by zero
points.condition: REM completes with rs2 equal to zero.

points.title: REMU by zero
points.condition: REMU completes with rs2 equal to zero.

points.title: DIV signed overflow
points.condition: DIV completes with rs1 = 0x80000000 and rs2 = 0xFFFFFFFF.

points.title: REM signed overflow
points.condition: REM completes with rs1 = 0x80000000 and rs2 = 0xFFFFFFFF.

points.title: DIV negative dividend positive divisor
points.condition: DIV completes with negative rs1, positive nonzero rs2.

points.title: DIV positive dividend negative divisor
points.condition: DIV completes with non-negative rs1 and negative rs2.

points.title: DIV both operands negative
points.condition: DIV completes with both operands negative, excluding overflow.

points.title: REM negative dividend nonzero result
points.condition: REM completes with negative rs1, nonzero divisor and nonzero result.

points.title: REM positive dividend negative divisor nonzero result
points.condition: REM completes with non-negative rs1, negative rs2 and nonzero result.

points.title: DIVU with high-bit dividend
points.condition: DIVU completes with rs1 bit 31 set and rs2 bit 31 clear, nonzero.

points.title: REMU dividend smaller than divisor
points.condition: REMU completes with rs1 < rs2, rs2 nonzero.

points.title: DIVU dividend smaller than divisor
points.condition: DIVU completes with rs1 < rs2, rs2 nonzero.

points.title: Equal operands
points.condition: A division completes with rs1 equal to rs2, nonzero.

points.title: Divisor one
points.condition: A division completes with rs2 equal to 1.

points.title: Zero dividend
points.condition: A division completes with rs1 zero and rs2 nonzero.

points.title: Remainder exactly zero
points.condition: A remainder instruction completes with result zero, nonzero rs1 and nonzero rs2.

points.title: Back-to-back division requests
points.condition: A new division request starts in the cycle right after a completion.

points.title: Non-division instruction ignored
points.condition: pcpi_valid with a non-division instruction while wait and ready are low.

points.title: Idle first cycle after reset
points.condition: First cycle after reset release with no request, no wait, ready or wr.

points.title: Long idle after reset
points.condition: At least 8 idle cycles with no valid, wait, ready or wr.

points.title: Completion after reset during activity
points.condition: A completion with write after a reset occurred while a request was pending.

points.title: Most negative dividend with other divisor
points.condition: A division completes with rs1 = 0x80000000 and rs2 neither zero nor -1.

points.title: Signed division by minus one without overflow
points.condition: DIV or REM completes with rs2 = -1 and rs1 not the most negative value.
